value.body:
Two changes. (1) Withdraw my earlier steer allowing several servers per eval job: an EvalJob names zero or one InferenceServer (`server=net` or nothing); remove `servers=` and the mapping form. Jack Heart: "Do we actually need two inference servers?" — no: one serve can host several models (Manabot's runtime already serves many policies by key), and a hosted LLM is called from play directly. Zero stays fully supported. The controller groups eval jobs onto a machine by the server they name; jobs naming different servers are separate groups. (2) Jack Heart: "there should be some sort of default for spinning up a machine to run evals". The no-default behaviour (wait until training is done unless a flag is given) is not accepted. Keep the threshold as one named default that is easy to change; its value is being decided with him — do not ship "no default".
